description: Defines the LogEntry interface representing a connection log entry with methods to access log details and JSON serialization, along with nested class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: LogEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a connection log entry with methods for retrieving log details and converting to JSON.

classes.name: LogEntry.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions for LogEntry properties.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with the log entry.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the log entry.

methods.name: getLogCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the log entry.

methods.name: getLogType
methods.description: Returns the type of the log entry.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the address if available.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the ThingId if available.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the LogEntry to a JsonObject including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the LogEntry to a JsonObject with specified schema version and field selector.
